name: Virtual machine software
definition: Program that runs one or more virtual machines or whole guest systems on the owner's computer.

name: Backup software
definition: Program that copies files, a disk or a whole system image to the owner's own drives. Backup to a provider's servers is in Subscriptions, Memberships & Online Services.

name: Data eraser
definition: Program that overwrites storage so that the erased data cannot be recovered.

name: File archiver
definition: Program that packs files into compressed archives and unpacks them.

name: Disc burning software
definition: Program that writes data, audio or disc images to optical discs.

name: Password manager
definition: Program or hosted tool that stores, generates and fills in passwords and logins. Family, premium and free plans are all included.

name: Office suite
definition: Bundle of word-processing, spreadsheet and presentation programs sold as one product.

name: PDF editor
definition: Program that views, annotates, edits, fills or signs PDF files.

name: Personal finance manager
definition: Program for tracking accounts, budgets and household money.

name: Code editor
definition: Program for writing, running and debugging source code.

name: App launcher
definition: Program that opens applications, files and commands from a typed name or shortcut.

name: 3D modelling software
definition: Program for modelling, sculpting and rendering three-dimensional objects.

name: Screen recorder and streaming software
definition: Program that records the screen or camera and streams it live. Recording and streaming are not split into separate products.

name: Audio editor
definition: Program for recording, editing and mastering sound.

name: Music production software
definition: Program for composing, arranging and recording music.

name: Accounting software
definition: Program for bookkeeping, invoicing and financial reporting for a business or a freelancer.

name: CRM software
definition: Program for managing customer contacts, deals and sales follow-up.

name: Version control software
definition: Program for tracking and sharing changes to source code.

name: Image editor
definition: Program for editing and painting pixel-based images.

name: Vector graphics editor
definition: Program for drawing and editing shape-based graphics that scale without loss.

name: Video editor
definition: Program for cutting, arranging and finishing video.

name: Video converter
definition: Program that converts video and audio files between formats and settings.

name: VPN
definition: VPN client, with the service it connects to, that encrypts the owner's connection and routes it through a private network.

name: Remote desktop software
definition: Program that shows and controls another computer's screen over a network.

name: Antivirus software
definition: Program that protects a computer or phone from malware and online threats; free antivirus, internet-security and total-security editions are one kind.

name: Media player
definition: Program that plays video and audio files of many formats.

name: Music player
definition: Program that plays music and organises the owner's music library.

name: Note-taking app
definition: App for writing, organising and searching personal notes.

name: Web browser
definition: Program for viewing websites.

name: Email client
definition: Program that reads and sends email from a mailbox hosted elsewhere. The mailbox itself is in Subscriptions, Memberships & Online Services.

name: BitTorrent client
definition: Program that downloads and shares files over the BitTorrent protocol.

name: SSH and FTP client
definition: Program that connects to remote servers by SSH or transfers files by FTP or SFTP.

name: Network analyser
definition: Program that captures and inspects network traffic.

name: Database software
definition: Program that stores, queries and manages structured data.

name: AI assistant
definition: AI assistant the user talks or writes to for answers, drafting, coding and other general tasks.

name: AI coding assistant
definition: Assistant sold or used as a tool that suggests, writes or reviews code.

name: CAD software
definition: Program for computer-aided design and drafting of parts, buildings and drawings.

name: GIS and mapping software
definition: Program on the owner's machine that edits, analyses or views geographic data. A hosted map or navigation service is in Subscriptions, Memberships & Online Services.

name: Compiler and runtime
definition: Program that compiles or runs code in a programming language.

name: Home publishing software
definition: Program for making cards, calendars, labels and similar printed items at home.

name: Task manager
definition: App for listing tasks, tracking their progress and planning projects.

name: Scientific software
definition: Program for scientific computation, statistics and data analysis.

name: Browser extension
definition: Add-on that adds features to one web browser.

name: Reference software
definition: Dictionary, encyclopedia or similar reference work delivered as its own program, or on a disc as a program. As an e-book file it is in Digital Media & Items.

name: PC cleaner
definition: Program that removes junk files and tunes settings to keep a computer clean and fast.

name: Uninstaller
definition: Program that removes installed applications together with their leftover files and settings.

name: Driver updater
definition: Program that finds out-of-date device drivers and installs newer ones.

name: 3D printing slicer
definition: Program that prepares a 3D model for printing by slicing it into printer instructions.

name: Tax software
definition: Program that prepares and files a tax return.

name: Point-of-sale software
definition: Program that runs a shop or restaurant till: sales, receipts, stock and payments.

name: Language-learning software
definition: Interactive program that teaches a language by testing, correcting or adapting to the user's answers.

name: Photo manager
definition: Program that catalogues, views and develops photographs, including camera RAW files.

name: Font manager
definition: Program that installs, organises and previews fonts.

name: AI image generator
definition: Program or hosted tool that makes or changes images from a text or image prompt; making new images and editing existing ones are the same product type.

name: Desktop search tool
definition: Program that indexes a computer's files and finds them by name or content.

name: Screenshot tool
definition: Program that captures and annotates what is shown on the screen.

name: Calendar app
definition: App for keeping a calendar and scheduling appointments.

name: Audio plug-in
definition: Plug-in (instrument or effect) that adds sound or image processing to an audio or graphics host program.

name: Creative suite
definition: All-apps bundle of one maker's creative programs, sold under its own name rather than after one program. Editions and plans are the same product.

name: Graphic design app
definition: Template-driven design app for flyers, social posts, resumes and similar layouts, fitting neither raster nor vector editing alone.

name: Desktop operating system
definition: Operating system that runs a desktop or laptop computer and its applications.

name: System utility suite
definition: Bundle of small system tools, such as window, file, keyboard and settings utilities, sold as one set rather than as a cleaner.

name: AI answer engine
definition: AI tool that answers questions or researches a topic with cited sources.

name: AI agent platform
definition: AI tool that carries out multi-step tasks on the user's behalf.

name: Code editor plug-in
definition: Add-on that adds features to one code editor or development environment.

name: Office suite add-in
definition: Add-in that adds features to an office or workspace suite.

name: Device feature unlock
definition: Paid unlock or subscription that switches on a function of software built into one device.

name: Device companion app
definition: App that records and shows the readings of one device and does nothing medical.

name: Game emulator
definition: Program that imitates a game console's, arcade board's or home computer's hardware so that its games run on the owner's computer or phone.

name: Game engine
definition: Program and framework for building video games, with rendering, physics, scripting and an editor (Unity, Unreal Engine, Godot).

name: Game mod manager
definition: Program that downloads, installs, orders and switches game mods in a game's files without being a game or a mod itself.

name: Download manager
definition: Program that queues, accelerates, pauses and resumes file downloads over HTTP, FTP and similar protocols.

name: File manager
definition: Program for browsing, copying, moving, renaming and organising files and folders, often in two panes.

name: Encryption software
definition: Program that encrypts whole drives, partitions, containers or single files so they open only with a key or password.

name: Parental controls
definition: Program or hosted filter that blocks or limits web content, apps and screen time for chosen users or devices.

name: OCR software
definition: Program that turns scanned pages, images and image-only PDFs into editable, searchable text.

name: Desktop publishing software
definition: Program for laying out multi-page documents such as magazines, books and brochures from text and images for print or screen.

name: Input method editor
definition: Program that turns keystrokes into the characters of a language such as Japanese or Chinese, using conversion dictionaries.

name: Circuit design software
definition: Program for drawing electronic schematics, laying out printed circuit boards and checking them for manufacture.

name: Word processor
definition: Program for writing, editing and formatting text documents, sold or distributed on its own, not only inside an office suite.

name: Groupware
definition: Program suite that shares schedules, workflows, bulletin boards and files among the staff of one organisation.

name: Singing voice synthesiser
definition: Program that sings entered lyrics and melody with a synthetic or sampled voice (Vocaloid type).

name: 2D animation software
definition: Program for drawing, rigging and timing two-dimensional animation, frame by frame or with cut-out puppets.

name: DJ software
definition: Program for mixing and beat-matching music tracks live on two or more virtual decks, often with a controller.

name: Mind mapping software
definition: Program for laying out ideas as branching maps around a central topic.

name: Data recovery software
definition: Program that recovers deleted, lost or corrupted files from drives, memory cards and damaged partitions.

name: ERP software
definition: Business-management suite that joins accounting, inventory, purchasing, sales and staff records in one system.

name: Machine translation software
definition: Program that translates text between languages automatically.

name: Computer-assisted translation tool
definition: Program that helps a human translator with translation memories, term bases and segment-by-segment editing.

name: Web design software
definition: Program for designing and building websites visually or in code, then publishing them.

name: E-learning authoring tool
definition: Program for building interactive courses, quizzes and slide lessons packaged for learning systems (SCORM).

name: Password recovery software
definition: Program that recovers or removes forgotten passwords of files, archives, accounts or devices.

name: Time-tracking software
definition: Program that records time spent on tasks and projects for billing, payroll or review.

name: Visual effects software
definition: Program that layers, keys and tracks video and CG elements into finished shots.

name: Photogrammetry software
definition: Program that builds 3D models or measured maps from sets of overlapping photographs.

name: Spreadsheet software
definition: Program for entering, calculating and charting data in grids of cells, sold or distributed on its own.

name: Presentation software
definition: Program for making slide presentations and showing them, sold or distributed on its own.

name: Partition manager
definition: Program that creates, resizes, moves, merges and converts disk partitions.

name: Planetarium software
definition: Program that shows the sky for a chosen place and time and simulates the motion of sky objects.

name: Typing tutor
definition: Program that teaches touch typing with drills that test and correct the user's keystrokes.

name: Text-to-speech software
definition: Program or hosted tool that turns written text into spoken audio with synthetic voices.

name: E-book reader
definition: Program that opens and shows e-book files (EPUB, MOBI and similar) and manages the owner's e-book library.

name: Web server software
definition: Program that serves websites or runs web applications for clients over a network.

name: Monitoring software
definition: Program or hosted tool that measures the performance, uptime and errors of running applications, servers and networks.

name: App compatibility layer
definition: Program that runs another operating system's applications directly, without a virtual machine or emulated hardware.

name: PC migration software
definition: Program that moves installed applications, settings and files from one computer to another.

name: Software modelling tool
definition: Program for drawing and keeping UML or similar models of software systems, often generating code from them.

name: Simulation software
definition: Program that simulates stress, flow, heat or other physics on a design before it is built.

name: Diagramming software
definition: Program for drawing flowcharts, org charts and network or floor diagrams from connected shapes.

name: Dictation software
definition: Program that turns the user's speech into typed text and voice commands.

name: Screenwriting software
definition: Program that formats scripts for film, TV and stage and manages scenes and characters.

name: Show-control software
definition: Program that plays audio, video and lighting cues in order for a live show.

name: Peer-to-peer file sharing client
definition: Program that shares and downloads files over Gnutella, eDonkey and similar networks other than BitTorrent.

name: Terminal emulator
definition: Program that shows a text terminal for a local shell, serial line or dial-up connection.

name: Survey and form software
definition: Program or hosted tool for building questionnaires and forms, collecting answers and reporting them.

name: Screen saver
definition: Program that shows animation or images on an idle screen, sold or distributed as its own product.

name: Collection cataloguing software
definition: Program that catalogues the owner's books, media or other collections, often by barcode scan.

name: Digital-signage software
definition: Program that schedules and plays content on public screens and displays.

name: Business intelligence software
definition: Program that joins data sources into dashboards, reports and visual analyses.

name: Workforce-management software
definition: Program for scheduling staff shifts, recording attendance and planning labour.

name: Firewall
definition: Program that allows or blocks a computer's or phone's network connections by application, port or address, sold on its own rather than inside a security suite. A firewall appliance is in Computers & Components.

name: Music notation software
definition: Program for writing, engraving and playing back sheet music in standard notation.

name: Online whiteboard
definition: Program or hosted tool giving a shared infinite canvas for sticky notes, sketches and workshops.
